how.mint: Mint in USDG, or in $FLYAI for {pct}% off. While minting is open every fly looks the same, so nobody can pick the rare ones.
how.reveal: Reveal. When minting ends, a future block's hash rolls every fly's traits in the contract itself: rarity (Common, Uncommon, Rare or Legendary), pose, colorway, background and gear. Anyone can check them on chain.
how.activate: Activate in USDG or $FLYAI. Active flies trade together on the desk. Every mint and every activation splits the same way: 80% into the flies' trading pool, 20% to the team. When a week ends above the pool's previous high, 95% of that profit goes to active flies in $FLYAI (5% to the team), weighted by rarity and by how long they were active. Registered FLYAI pets, our physical tamagotchis, share it too at 3.5x. Sell a fly and it stops; the new holder activates it again.
how.risk: Trading can lose money, and a week without profit pays nothing. Nothing here promises a return.

odds.title: Rarity chances
odds.reveal: Every fly looks the same while the mint is open. When it ends (the reveal), a future block's hash rolls every fly's rarity and traits inside the contract, so nobody can pick or see them before, the team included. The counts are exact: there will be 33 Legendary flies, not about 33. Rarity sets a fly's share of the payouts, never how it trades.
